identity.qr_bad_format: Code {value} is not a valid device ID
error.hw_com_disconnected.title: Board not connected
error.hw_com_disconnected.cause: The USB connection to the board was lost.
error.hw_com_disconnected.action:
Check the USB cable at both ends.
Press Refresh ports.
Select the board's port and press Try again.
error.hw_no_port.title: No board found
error.hw_no_port.cause: No serial port for the board was found.
error.hw_no_port.action:
Plug in the board's USB cable.
Press Refresh ports.
error.hw_port_busy.title: Port in use
error.hw_port_busy.cause: Another program is using the board's port.
error.hw_port_busy.action:
Close other programs that use the port (for example a serial monitor).
Press Try again.
error.hw_timeout.title: Board did not answer
error.hw_timeout.cause: The board did not reply in time.
error.hw_timeout.action:
Check the cable and that the board has power.
Press Try again.
error.hw_device_error.title: Board error
error.hw_device_error.action:
Unplug the board and plug it in again.
Press Try again.
If it keeps failing, reject the device.
error.hw_flash_failed.title: Upload failed
error.hw_flash_failed.cause: The firmware could not be written to the board.
error.hw_flash_failed.action:
Keep the board connected.
Press Retry upload.
error.hw_hold_boot.title: Hold the BOOT button
error.hw_hold_boot.cause: This board needs the BOOT button to start programming.
error.hw_hold_boot.action:
Press and hold the BOOT button on the board.
Press Try again.
Release BOOT when the progress bar starts.
error.api_unreachable.title: Server not reachable
error.api_unreachable.cause: The Parkomate server could not be reached.
error.api_unreachable.action:
Check the network cable or Wi-Fi of this PC.
Press Try again.
If it continues, call the supervisor.
error.api_unauthorised.title: Server refused this station
error.api_unauthorised.cause: The station's access key was rejected.
error.api_unauthorised.action: Call the supervisor: the server access key must be renewed.
error.api_bad_response.title: Unexpected server reply
error.api_bad_response.cause: The server sent data the station does not understand.
error.api_bad_response.action:
Press Try again.
If it continues, call the supervisor.
error.whitelist_denied.title: Device not authorised
error.whitelist_denied.cause: This board's MAC address is not on the server list.
error.whitelist_denied.action:
Reject the device.
Give it to the supervisor.
error.fw_hash_mismatch.title: Firmware damaged
error.fw_hash_mismatch.cause: The downloaded firmware failed its integrity check.
error.fw_hash_mismatch.action:
Press Try again to download it again.
If it continues, call the supervisor.
error.fw_not_loaded.title: Firmware not ready
error.fw_not_loaded.cause: The firmware has not been downloaded yet.
error.fw_not_loaded.action:
Wait until the firmware is loaded.
Press Try again.
error.meas_timeout.title: No measurement received
error.meas_timeout.cause: The measuring device did not send values within {seconds} seconds.
error.meas_timeout.action:
Check that the measuring device is switched on and connected to Wi-Fi.
Check the test clips on the board.
Press Measure again.
error.meas_bad_data.title: Measurement unreadable
error.meas_bad_data.cause: The measuring device sent incomplete or invalid data.
error.meas_bad_data.action:
Press Measure again.
If it continues, restart the measuring device.
error.cam_not_found.title: Camera not found
error.cam_not_found.cause: The QR camera is not connected or is used by another program.
error.cam_not_found.action:
Check the camera's USB cable.
Press Try again.
error.qr_unreadable.title: QR code not readable
error.qr_unreadable.cause: The camera could not read the QR sticker.
error.qr_unreadable.action:
Hold the sticker flat inside the frame, about 10 cm from the camera.
Avoid glare from lights.
Press Scan again.
error.qr_bad_format.title: Wrong QR code
error.qr_bad_format.cause: The code read is not a valid device ID.
error.qr_bad_format.action:
Check that the correct QR sticker is used.
Press Scan again.
error.id_write_failed.title: Could not set device ID
error.id_write_failed.cause: The board did not accept the new ID.
error.id_write_failed.action:
Keep the board connected.
Press Try again.
If it continues, reject the device.
error.mail_failed.title: E-mail not sent
error.mail_failed.cause: The report e-mail could not be sent. It is saved and will be sent later.
error.mail_failed.action:
No action is needed now.
If this repeats, tell the supervisor.
error.mail_not_configured.title: E-mail not set up
error.mail_not_configured.cause: Report e-mail is switched off or incomplete in the settings.
error.mail_not_configured.action:
Reports are saved on this PC.
Ask the supervisor to set up e-mail.
error.db_error.title: Data could not be saved
error.db_error.cause: The station's database reported an error.
error.db_error.action:
Do not continue with this device.
Restart the application.
If it continues, call the supervisor.
error.settings_invalid.title: Settings problem
error.settings_invalid.action: Call the supervisor to correct the settings.
error.secret_missing.title: Password not stored
error.secret_missing.cause: A required password or key ({name}) is missing on this PC.
error.secret_missing.action: Ask the supervisor to store it with: python -m parkomate secrets set {name}
error.report_failed.title: Report not created
error.report_failed.cause: The report file could not be written.
error.report_failed.action:
Check that the disk is not full.
Export the report again from the admin area.
error.auth_invalid_credentials.title: Login failed
error.auth_invalid_credentials.cause: Operator ID or password is wrong.
error.auth_invalid_credentials.action:
Check your operator ID.
Type the password again.
error.auth_locked.title: Account locked
error.auth_locked.cause: Too many wrong passwords. Locked for {minutes} more minute(s).
error.auth_locked.action:
Wait {minutes} minute(s) and try again.
Or ask the supervisor to unlock your account.
error.auth_inactive.title: Account switched off
error.auth_weak_password.title: Password too short
error.auth_weak_password.cause: The password must have at least {min} characters.
error.auth_duplicate_operator.title: Operator ID already used
error.auth_duplicate_operator.cause: Another operator already has the ID {code}.
error.permission_denied.title: Not allowed
error.permission_denied.cause: Only a supervisor (admin) can do this.
error.invalid_state.title: Action not possible now
error.invalid_state.cause: This step cannot be done at this point of the process.
error.invalid_state.action:
Follow the steps on the screen.
If the screen looks wrong, call the supervisor.
error.invalid_input.title: Invalid value
error.invalid_input.cause: The value entered has the wrong format.
error.invalid_input.action: Check the value and enter it again.
error.not_found.title: Not found
error.not_found.cause: The requested record does not exist.
error.not_found.action: Refresh the screen and try again.
error.unexpected.title: Unexpected problem
error.unexpected.cause: Something went wrong in the application.
error.unexpected.action:
Press Try again.
If it continues, restart the application and tell the supervisor.
error.wip_not_found.title: Board not found
error.wip_not_found.cause: No board on the line has the ID {value}.
error.wip_not_found.action:
Scan the QR code again.
Check that the sticker belongs to this board.
If it continues, call the supervisor.
error.wip_finished.title: Board already finished
error.wip_finished.action:
Do not work on it again.
If it was rejected, put it back in its reject box.
Call the supervisor if unsure.
error.wip_claimed.title: Board is on another bench
error.wip_claimed.cause: This board is being worked on at {station}.
error.wip_claimed.action:
Give the board back to that station.
If that station has stopped, call the supervisor.
error.wip_wrong_operation.title: Wrong station for this board
error.wip_wrong_operation.cause: This board needs {op} next, which is not done at this station.
error.wip_wrong_operation.action: Put the board in the tray for {op}.
error.wip_step_not_selected.title: Step not in your list
error.wip_step_not_selected.cause: This board needs {op} next, which is not one of your steps.
error.wip_step_not_selected.action: Add {op} to your steps, or put the board in the tray for {op}.

error.meas_listen_failed.action:

Restart the application.
If it continues, call the supervisor to change the measurement port.
